forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a token to reset your password.
forgot.sentText: If {{ email }} is registered, you'll receive a token in the next few minutes.
forgot.spam: Please also check your spam folder.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter the token you received by email and choose a new password.
reset.policy: At least 8 characters, one uppercase letter and one number.
reset.successText: You can now log in with your new password.
reset.error: The token is invalid or has expired.
